Title: Azure Backup support for large disks up to 32 TB is now generally available

Body.Content:
Azure Backup support for larger and more powerful Azure Managed Disks of up to 32 TB is now generally available. The backups for your virtual machines—including each disk size up to 32 TB and a maximum of 256 TB for all disks in a VM combined—should work seamlessly without any impact to your existing backups. No user action is required to get the backups running for the large sized disks, if the virtual machine is already configured with Azure Backup. 

Support for encrypted VMs with disks greater than 4 TB in size is coming soon.

  • Learn more about Azure Backup, and read the Azure Backup documentation.
  • If you have questions, please contact Azure Backup forum for support.
  • Tell us how we can improve Azure Backup, contribute new ideas and vote on existing ones.
  • Follow us on Twitter @AzureBackup for the latest news and updates.
